notes: Assessment: @latinamericatravel ("Latin America Travel", ~298K Instagram followers, listed as a regional cultural/adventure travel account) is a brand/thematic account, not an individual creator, and no original itinerary content attributable to it was found. Web searches for the handle plus itinerary/guide keywords returned only unrelated tour-operator itineraries (Wanderlust, Journeys International, Enchanting Travels, Totally Latin America) and YouTube videos by other creators that merely use #latinamericatravel as a hashtag - none of that content belongs to this handle and none was extracted. The account's Instagram profile page itself could not be fetched (Instagram requires login), and no bio-link website, blog, or guides page for this handle surfaced in search. Recommend treating this handle as a repost/aggregator account in the pilot.
